notes.title: Difficulty Update - 2025.04.21
notes.notes:
[h1]Difficulty Selection[/h1]

We've received some feedback at HR about some employees wanting to adjust their work contracts in regards to wrongful termination lawsuits. Thus, from now on, the new company policy is for employees to choose their contract type, [u]Normal[/u] or [i]Hard[/i]. Depending on their contract type, wrongful termination will have different impacts. Contracts of type Normal will have the employees restart their overtime work on that day, while the contracts of type Hard are like the originals, resulting in the complete reset of an employee's work.

[b]Changelog[/b]
[list]
[*] When selecting New Game, the user now receives a pop up with difficulty selection
- Normal: On death, the player gets reset to the start of the day
- Hard: On death, the player loses all progress
[*] Adjusted wall paint so that it all changes color at the same time
[*] Fixed pesky teleportations resulting in an unfortunate void experience
[*] Prevented teleportation into unexpected rooms and situations
[/list]

notes.title: Difficulty Update - 2025.03.31
notes.notes:
[h1]The Office Map[/h1]

To increase productivity of lost employees, we have now added a map to the lobby to help them visualize the office.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45355579/6bb69c538af6425da20094be8de34698deb00436.png[/img]


[h1]Entities[/h1]

We've received complaints at HR regarding some.. uncooperative coworkers on the office floor. We've implemented some new policies to help employees perform their overtime tasks with less frustrating interruptions. This includes taking away the coffee machines from the break room, so that some entities are a bit slower. We've also enabled the sixth sense of any overtime employees, so that you can visually sense if an entity is closeby.

[h1]Changelog[/h1]
[list]
[*]Added a map to the lobby
[*]Increased audio ranges on each entity
[*]Reduced movement speed of certain entities, as well as preventing them from spawning on top of you
[*]Added a visual distortion of the screen whenever the player is close to an entity, so that you have a visual and auditory cue
[*]Added a setting to permanently toggle the crosshair
[*]Gameover will now contain a simple reason as to why
[*]A prompt should now appear when Steam is not correctly initialized, as we rely on it for our Input API
[*]Moved an intercom away from a door to prevent getting stuck
[*]Fixed multiple anomaly interactions that could lead to softlocks
[*]Fixed Office Tour achievement being unachievable
[*]Adjusted colliders of some objects
[*]Hired a new receptionist
[/list]
